name: Bioinformatics & Computational Biology
summary: Bioinformatics and Computational Biology use computing, statistics, and mathematics to analyze biological data such as DNA sequences and protein structures. The major combines biology with programming.
description: This major prepares students to work with the enormous datasets generated by modern biology, such as genome sequences, gene expression data, and protein structures. Students take biology, chemistry, and genetics along with computer science courses in programming (commonly Python and R), algorithms, and databases, plus statistics and linear algebra. Specialized courses cover sequence analysis, genomics, structural biology, systems biology, and machine learning in biology. Students work with real datasets and often conduct research. Graduates are in high demand in biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, genomics labs, hospitals, and research institutes.
